gui.skyabyss.trial.title: Trial Board
gui.skyabyss.trial.codex.empty: Trials you have not seen keep their names hidden
gui.skyabyss.trial.weekly_open: Open even if not drawn. Doubles the materials
gui.skyabyss.trial.help: Each cycle draws one trial from Walk, Wit and Fight
message.skyabyss.trial.board_far: The board is too far. Step closer
message.skyabyss.trial.stone_not_yours: This stone belongs to another party's trial
message.skyabyss.trial.first: First time through %s. Added to the codex
message.skyabyss.trial.title: Title earned
message.skyabyss.trial.w02.start: Beams hold still while the bell rings. Cross from beam to beam to the far ledge
message.skyabyss.trial.w02.fell: You slipped. Back to the rest point
message.skyabyss.trial.w02.crossed: You reached the far ledge. Ring the stone
message.skyabyss.trial.w02.bell_cooling: The bell is still cooling. %s s
message.skyabyss.trial.w02.bell_held: You struck the bell. The beams hold for %s s
message.skyabyss.trial.w06.start: Strike the ribs back in the order shown on the wall. A mistake starts over
message.skyabyss.trial.w06.recall: Press the lectern to see the score again for a moment
message.skyabyss.trial.w06.solved: The score falls silent. The far door opens
message.skyabyss.trial.w07.start: Three of the four handles are alive. Open all three sluices within the grace time and hold. %s weight stones
message.skyabyss.trial.w07.opened: All three sluices are open. The far door opens
message.skyabyss.trial.w07.flooded: This handle is flooded and does nothing now
message.skyabyss.trial.w07.pulled: A sluice is open. Open the rest within %s s
message.skyabyss.trial.w10.start: Run from cover to cover and bring down the gunners on the rise. Read the cannon telegraph
message.skyabyss.trial.w10.cleared: The gunners are down. The door before the stone opens
trial.skyabyss.cell.W01.desc: Cross the rib valley on crumbling bone footing.
trial.skyabyss.cell.W02.desc: A vertical shaft of beams that hold still to the bell's beat.
trial.skyabyss.cell.W05.desc: Carry light sprouts through dark waterways and light the stands.
trial.skyabyss.cell.W06.desc: Strike the ribs back to the wall's score.
trial.skyabyss.cell.W07.desc: Open three sluices at once with distant handles.
trial.skyabyss.cell.W09.desc: Hold out against waves of sentinels in a sealing hall.
trial.skyabyss.cell.W10.desc: Follow the cover and bring down the gunners on the rise.
trial.skyabyss.cell.T01.desc: Carry a pearl to the altar during the ebb.
trial.skyabyss.cell.T05.desc: Move the water level to climb to the ledge.
trial.skyabyss.cell.T09.desc: Break three nests and fell the Tide Caller.
trial.skyabyss.cell.S01.desc: Climb the bone with updrafts and gliding rings.
trial.skyabyss.cell.S05.desc: Route lightning with wires and levers to the door pillar.
trial.skyabyss.cell.S06.desc: Bend light with feather mirrors onto three receivers.
trial.skyabyss.cell.E01.desc: Scatter ash to make a cooled crust path over lava.
trial.skyabyss.cell.E05.desc: Forge the fire key at the great furnace.
trial.skyabyss.cell.E09.desc: Tend the hearth fire and keep it burning.
